Petrof upright - hammers reshaped and hammer springs changed!

Tags: update

The first step in the new big project of mine was hammer reshaping. The original hammers had significant grooves. Lets see how they will play. I can always change them if needed later.

I also changed the hammer springs as the original ones were well aged and too weak.
